summary: A Depth 20 subscribe: refused with the web adapter's words and status partial, nothing sent upstream; a Depth 5 subscribe after it streams the five-level FULL book.

notes: The web answers a Depth subscribe at any depth but 5 with an error entry, "Invalid depth level 20. Paytm supports only 5 levels", and status partial (paytm_adapter.py:388-391, websocket_proxy/server.py:1318-1334); the desktop refuses it at admission with the same words (feed/refusals.rs, lane life; BKD-06).

deviations.reason: The web passes Paytm's trade time on in epoch seconds; WebSocket times are epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md, CLAUDE.md), so a client reading ltt as ms on the web lands in January 1970. The desktop sends milliseconds.
